body.objective: Construct or exactly obstruct Candidate A: the smallest action-derived dressed R(g_hat)^2 repair of the compact-support dressed-trace class, using an auxiliary scalar to expose a second-order causal parent and the physical scalar sign.
body.stop_condition: Import COMPLEX_COMPENSATOR_ACTION_QUARTET_PREFLIGHT_V1 from commit 306ff78a2 and TAU_ADIC_VACUUM_CYLINDER_CAUSAL_BV_TRACE_OBSTRUCTION_V1 from commit 2b834dc751d6948366fd5c3d99174c268fa50d21 by exact hashes. On the same unit vacuum-cylinder conventions, start with S_C2 + beta integral sqrt(-g_hat) R(g_hat)^2 plus the frozen clock sector and rewrite the R^2 block as chi R - chi^2/(4 beta). Derive the complete minimal, nonminimal and antifield BV rows and the full non-Einstein Hessian from the action; prove CME, Q^2=0, cyclicity, real structure and the Weyl-quartet contraction exactly. Construct or obstruct support-local advanced/retarded Green homotopies for the complete second-order parent. Determine whether u=phi_trace-2 tau becomes a healthy hyperbolic scalar, becomes contractible through chi, or survives as a negative, nonhyperbolic or topological physical direction. Compute the reduced Lee-Wald/current pairing and all scalar zero modes. Add M^2 R(g_hat)/2 only if an exact massless-scalar or zero-mode obstruction requires it, recording why and checking m0^2=M^2/(12 beta) on an Einstein control while taking the cylinder verdict from the full Hessian. Recompute the zero-charge D sector and the Berger-clock compatibility gate. Emit an action hash, exact block matrices, causal certificate, independent action-variation and homology rails, and a PASS/FAIL disposition against the seven common comparison gates.
body.current_gate: Candidate A auxiliary-scalaron causal and physical-sign preflight on the vacuum cylinder
body.forbid: no metric-only fourth-order scalar analysis; no scalaron called healthy from its mass formula alone; no Einstein-background factorization substituted for the non-Einstein cylinder Hessian; no M^2 R term added without a certified necessity; no Wess-Zumino hbar term used as a classical inverse; no sampled-mode disappearance of u promoted to homology elimination; no D-gauge or Berger-clock preservation inferred without charge and Cartan checks; no anomaly, Hadamard, particle, scattering or unitarity claim
activates: a receiver-valid changed-action causal parent if Candidate A passes
body.resource_hint: PRIORITY CLASSICAL REPAIR A. The prerequisite artifacts are already committed, so this item is input-pinned rather than dependency-gated. Preserve exact action identity for the A/B comparison.
notes: Candidate A is the physically richer route because a genuine scalar may remain after reduction.
The auxiliary chi formulation is mandatory: the comparison concerns the complete causal parent and reduced physical pairing, not only the fourth-order trace polynomial.
A negative, nonhyperbolic or uncontrolled scalar is a successful terminal obstruction.
